note: Pin registry, 011-convention, enforced not declared: before adjudicating anything harness/score.py compares every non-null member here against the live artefact — the preregistration, matrix and adapterSpec digests when filled, the jpack binary digest always, harnessPython.version exactly, harnessPython.pipFreezeSha256 against `pip freeze` in the running interpreter, and the cf probe runner's self-report (node version, clone commit, tracked-tree cleanliness, per-file digests of every probed upstream source) against cloudflareOs — and verifies harness/STUDY-MANIFEST.sha256 as an exact set in the same pass. Any mismatch is terminal: the attempt is pipeline-invalid and nothing is adjudicated.

cloudflareOs.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE at the pin); the repository is described by Cloudflare as a v2 early-access rewrite with no tagged release, so the commit is the only available behavioral baseline
cloudflareOs.install: git clone <repo> && git -C cloudflare-os checkout b2a51b5 && corepack-pinned pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts (upstream's own pnpm-lock.yaml; no postinstall scripts exist in the workspace; --ignore-scripts additionally keeps dependency build scripts inert — the probes execute none of them)
cloudflareOs.importNote: The probes import tools.ts, auto-approval.ts, mock-storage.ts and typed-storage/src/index.ts as live code from the pinned clone (never vendored), bundled per invocation by the clone's own esbuild (upstream's vitest path needs a newer glibc than this apparatus provides — same pinned sources either way) and run under the pinned node. overseer.ts supplies the ActionRecord and AutoApproveTagRecord types harness/typecheck.py holds every retained record to, via the clone's own typescript under the backend package's own tsconfig. cloudflare:workers is aliased to probes/stubs/cloudflare-workers.ts, whose only runtime export used is an inert tracing object — the study's single injected seam, on the observability path only.
cloudflareOs.upstreamCiNode: 22.14.0 (the upstream repository's own CI pin, recorded as context; the harness pin below is what is enforced)
cloudflareOs.backendTypecheckFinding: WITHDRAWN. An earlier draft recorded that binding fixtures to the server-side ActionRecord was not reproducible from the committed tree because the backend needed a wrangler-regenerated worker-configuration.d.ts. That was wrong: the file is tracked at the pin (git ls-files packages/workshop-backend/worker-configuration.d.ts), and `node scripts/build-format-blueprints.mjs` (run from the package directory, as the package's own test script does) followed by tsc -p packages/workshop-backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit exits 0 with zero diagnostics and leaves the tracked tree clean. The gate binds the real server-side type accordingly; see DEVIATIONS.md.
cloudflareOs.runtimeValidationNote: The platform DOES validate at its live RPC boundary: ApprovalQueueImpl carries @validateRpc() (overseer.ts:9428), so submitAction's arguments — including the declared structure of ActionDescription — are checked on arrival by validators generated from the pinned TypeScript types at build time. What it ships no part of is OFFLINE verification of a retained or exported action record: those validators are inline closures inside the built Worker, bound to a live service method, structural only (every semantic commitment is an unconstrained string), and there is no digest, signature or action-log export anywhere in the pinned source. The study's load-bearing claim is the second sentence, and only the second.

harnessPython.requirements: harness/requirements.txt (rfc8785 for JCS, pytest for the suite); the venv holds nothing else
harnessPython.note: adapter uses rfc8785 from this venv for JCS; there is no OWP-style upstream Python dependency in this study

harnessNode.note: the node that runs the cf probe runner; self-reported by the runner per attempt and compared here by the scorer. Upstream pins 22.14.0 in its own CI; the divergence is recorded in cloudflareOs.upstreamCiNode and the probes depend on no 22.14-vs-22.23 behavior

matrix.note: locked-replication cell expectations; digest filled at the freeze together with the preregistration digest. The frozen cell-id set is additionally asserted in harness/score.py, so a reduced registry cannot satisfy zero divergence

matrixHoldout.note: reviewer-authored holdout stratum, committed verbatim with attribution and never executed pre-freeze; score.py --include-holdout is refused mechanically while preregistration.sha256 is null

studyManifest.covers: PREREGISTRATION.md, PREREG-REVIEW.md, adapter/SPEC.md, harness/MATRIX.json, harness/MATRIX-HOLDOUT.json, harness/PINS.json, harness/requirements.txt, the vendored pack and conformance-case bytes, every adapter/*.py and harness/*.py (tests included), every probes/*.ts and probes/stubs/*.ts, and every fixtures/**/MANIFEST.sha256 across both strata
studyManifest.note: exact-set whole-study manifest; regenerated during drafting, pinned at the freeze. No digest is recorded here because this file is inside the manifest's own coverage

preregistration.note: Filled with the file's digest at the freeze, so a post-freeze edit is detectable. Null until then; the scorer refuses a registered (non-pilot) run while null.

adapterSpec.note: registered with the preregistration; digest filled at the freeze

probeToolchain.note: The two clone-provided tools that transform or check study inputs: esbuild bundles every probe entrypoint, typescript runs the fixture typecheck. Both are resolved from the pinned clone's own lockfile and both are self-reported per attempt by the upstream runner and compared here by the scorer — round 1 found esbuild was self-reported and never pinned.
